name: Sample customer revenue
provenance: Synthetic SQL Server and PostgreSQL footprint fixtures; proposed business meaning, not a published ontology

concepts.name: Customer
concepts.description: A synthetic customer identified by customer_id

concepts.name: Order
concepts.description: A synthetic order associated with exactly one customer

concepts.name: Customer revenue
concepts.description: Sum of order amount minus discount at one row per customer and region; this fixture's definition is not a universal revenue definition

relations.description: Customer places orders; physical evidence is the orders.customer_id foreign key
At most one aggregate row per customer in this fixture; customers without orders have no row because the view uses an inner join
